_comment: Filing, correction and appeal limits from public sources. 'verified' / 'appeal_verified' mean the limit was read in the cited public document; unverified entries are flagged to reviewers. Appeal clocks: the latest of the listed clocks applies; an empty list means the window is not known and no deadline is computed (ADR-032). The federal floor (42 CFR 447.45(d)(1)) requires states to accept claims submitted within 12 months of the date of service.

UT.name: Utah Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Utah Medicaid Provider Manual, Section I: General Information (September 2026), 11-6.4 Time Limit to Submit Medicaid Claims: 365 days from the date of service; 'any adjustments or corrections must also be received within the 365-day time period', https://medicaid.utah.gov/Documents/manuals/pdfs/Medicaid%20Provider%20Manuals/All%20Providers%20General%20Information%20Section%20I/AllProvidersGeneralInfo_Section_1.pdf
Utah Medicaid Provider Agreement: amended claims accepted up to 365 days after date of service, https://medicaid.utah.gov/Documents/pdfs/agreement2011.pdf
appeal_citations: Utah Medicaid Provider Manual, Section I (September 2026), 5-4 Hearings and Administrative Review: 'the aggrieved person has 30 days to request a hearing' from a claim determination; adjustments or resubmissions do not extend it. Utah Admin. Code R410-14.

AZ.name: AHCCCS (fee-for-service)
citations: A.R.S. 36-2904(G); AHCCCS FFS Provider Billing Manual, Chapter 4 General Billing Rules, Claim Submission Time Frames: initial claim within 6 months of the date of service, clean-claim status or adjustment within 12 months, https://azahcccs.gov/PlansProviders/Downloads/FFSProviderManual/FFS_Chap04GeneralBillingRules.pdf
appeal_citations: AHCCCS FFS Provider Billing Manual, Chapter 28 Claim Disputes, Time Limits for Filing a Dispute: within 12 months from the ending date of service (or eligibility posting), or within 60 days after the denial of a timely claim, whichever is later, https://azahcccs.gov/PlansProviders/Downloads/FFSProviderManual/FFS_Chap28ClaimDisputes.pdf
The eligibility-posting clock is not modeled: the synthetic data has no retroactive eligibility postings.

NV.name: Nevada Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Nevada Medicaid and Nevada Check Up Billing Manual (updated 02/20/2026), Chapter 7 'What is the timely filing (stale date) period?': 180 days from the date of service for in-state claims without TPL (365 with TPL or out-of-state), https://www.medicaid.nv.gov/Downloads/provider/NV_Billing_General_20260220.pdf

Same manual, Chapter 8 'Adjustments and Voids': 'Adjustments and voids must be submitted within the stale date period outlined in Chapter 7'; resubmitting a denied claim is a resubmission under the same period.
appeal_citations: Nevada Medicaid Billing Manual (02/20/2026), Chapter 8 'Claim Appeals': no later than 30 calendar days from the date on the remittance advice listing the claim as denied; no new window for a resubmitted same-service claim (MSM Chapter 100, Section 105.2C).

ID.name: Idaho Medicaid (fee-for-service)
citations: Idaho Medicaid Provider Handbook, General Billing Instructions (December 23, 2025), 1.12 Timely Filing Limit: complete claim submitted and ICN assigned within 12 months (365 days) of the start date of service, https://www.idmedicaid.com/General%20Information/General%20Billing%20Instructions.pdf
Same handbook, 1.12.8 Resubmissions: a resubmission beyond timely filing needs proof of timely filing attached, and services not on the original claim are denied.
appeal_citations: Not found in the General Billing Instructions; its Appeals section defers to the 'General Information and Requirements for Providers' handbook, which has not been read yet. No deadline is computed for Idaho appeals.
